name: Computer Engineering & Consulting Ltd
summary: Computer Engineering & Consulting, Ltd. (CEC), established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1968, is a prominent player in the nation's digital industry and system integration landscape. The company specializes in delivering a broad spectrum of information and communication technology (ICT) services, with a significant emphasis on supporting the manufacturing sector. Its comprehensive service portfolio spans the entire lifecycle of system management, encompassing development, construction, ongoing maintenance, and operational support. Additionally, CEC provides expert assistance for ICT implementation and operations, offers advanced security solutions, aids in the deployment of packaged software, and supplies temporary staffing services.
